limitations: Fake protocol backend does not qualify actual UI routing, mounted target incarnation/lifetimes, layout/images or complete P9 workloads.
Backend construction/closure and its retained storage remain caller-owned. No rollback/reset is implied.
Callbacks must honor context and budgets; Runner cannot preempt arbitrary blocking backend callbacks.
MaxCheckpointBytes is compact checkpoint encoding accounting, not byte-exact heap or whole Result serialization accounting; bounded transient encoding buffers and object/slice overhead are separate.
reviewed_invariants: Whole bounded record validation/detachment before backend callbacks; owned record and checkpoint identities/payloads.
Self identity, typed-nil refusal and atomic busy gate prevent copied/concurrent/reentrant use; deferred busy release survives panic/Goexit unwinding.
One explicit UTC scheduling clock; manifest checks, steps and captures do not advance time. Worker selection/advance remain explicit operations.
Ready/running/awaiting/due/blocked remain observable; future-only timers are current-instant idle without implicit execution.
Shared operation/dispatch budget, bounded step quantum and validated partial progress preserve prefix accounting. Error residual is last successful inspection, not a new state.
Raw per-capture admission, capture count and compact checkpoint retention bounded separately; padded raw backing capacity is not retained.
scope: Read-only Record/Runner source, corrected retention/time/residual contract, frozen qualification graph and isolated adversarial regressions. No GUI, Prism, canonical mutations or concrete managed driver acceptance.
